---

PATTERN:
- Stop hook fires → state='idle' → worker walks from desk to break room
- New tool call fires → state='typing'/'reading' → worker walks back to desk
- Break room spots assigned by desk index so workers spread out
- Workers face DOWN (toward viewer) while relaxing in break room
- Workers face UP (toward screen) when at desk

WHY: User's explicit requirement — 'if you're working then you're working, idle should be only when message is sent and you need to reply'

GOTCHA: Previously broke this with client-side timers and post-tool-use idle. Now ONLY Stop hook triggers idle/break room walk. setWorkerState() in worker-entity.ts handles the break room targeting.
